sloka: गायनैः च विराविण्यो वादनैः च तथ अपरैः ।विरेजुर् विपुलाः तत्र सर्व रत्न समन्विताः ॥१-१८-१९॥
transliteration: gāyanaiḥ ca virāviṇyo vādanaiḥ ca tatha aparaiḥ ।virejur vipulāḥ tatra sarva ratna samanvitāḥ ॥1-18-19॥

translations.english: The king distributed deserving gifts to priests, euologists and genealogists. He gave brahmins in charity thousands of cows and other valuables.
